tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// yang lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du 'khor lo bde mchog bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus rang gi sems pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog tu gyur par bsgom/ de yang sku mdog sngon po padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas gri gug 'dzin pas phyogs bcur bsdigs shing*/ g.yon pas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan zhing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal yod pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis ka stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa zung 'jug gi sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar bsgom/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ bsam/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas 'khor lo bde mchog sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba rang gi mdun du spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shuddho3 ham̐ gis rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de ltar lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de yid mnyam par gzhag sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las yig 'bru 'phros pas yab kyi zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi mkha' nas 'thon/ yab kyi gsang gnas su zhugs nas 'khor ba'i 'od kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs rang gi rgyud la zhugs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus pa bzla'o// de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa byed par 'dod na/ mchod pa bshams pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas ma dag pa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo'i sgra rnams ngo bo bzang zhing nam mkha' gang bar bskyed/ de nas mdun du dmigs pa'i rten yod dam med kyang rung ste/ rang gis bsgoms pa ltar 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba bskyed pa la snga ma ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bstim/ de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra samba ra maṇḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī zhes thams cad la sbyar la/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab/ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo dbul/ de nas nang mchod sngar bzhin bsang zhing sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs mtheb srin gyis gtor zhing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa mchod par bzhes/ zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa thams cad mchod par bzhes/ zhes brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ rang gi sngags kyis yi dam dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod par bzhes/ zhes pas de dag la mchod nas/ lce/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg pas rang gi lus kyi lha mchod nas/ chos skyong srung ma dang*/ 'byung po thams cad mchod ces pas de dag la dbul lo// de nas chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod do// de nas gtor ma sbyangs pa gong gi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs pas mdun bskyed kyi he ru ka dang lha thams cad la mchod par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ ā ralli ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya ho/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ snga ma ltar mchod nas bdag gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i phud mchod gral dang*/ gtor mar phul bas lha dang 'byung po rnams mchod nas shes rab kyi rdzas las kyi slob mas/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'du ba rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa yang*// rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du bzhes// zhes pas drang*/ len pa pos/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i// de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// zhes brjod cing blang*/

phud kyis sngar ltar mchod nas/ rang gi snying gar bla ma dang lha/ lte bar chos skyong dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad dmigs la mchod par bsam zhing longs spyad/ kha zas kyang de dang 'dra bar longs spyad do// thabs kyi rdzas la ba la/ shes rab kyi rdzas la ma da na/ bza' ba la kri pi ta/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod par bya'o// gnas skabs thams cad du lha'i rnal 'byor ma nyams par bya'o// bza' btung gis tshim pa dang*/ lhag ma bsdus pa nang mchod kyi kha phrus btab nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ u tstshiṣṭa ba linta/ bhakṣa sī swā hās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la byin nas/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pa// bden pa 'dis ni lha mo 'di dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces pa dang*/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pas dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos la/ oṃ badzra muḥ/ zhes brjod pas mdun bskyed gshegs su gsol la/ rang gi gnas gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis bsrungs nas/ las kyi rjes bsdus la/ ci bde bar spyad do// tshogs kyi mchod pa'i cho ga'o// //spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ oṃ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha/ āḥzhes brjod pas/ brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad ting nge 'dzin/ de thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bsams la yul rnams la sdang zhen med par spyad do// nub mo nyal ba'i tshe chos thams cad 'ga' yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal/ nang par ldang ba'i tshe lha'i sku'i nga rgyal gyis ldang ngo*// de ltar rgyun du rnal 'byor du byed cing*/ dam tshig rnam par dag pa la gnas pa ni ring por mi thogs par he ru ka chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// tshul 'di sngags 'chang 'phags pa la// dge bshes jo sras phag mchu yis// bskul ba'i don du sbyar ba yi// dge bas sangs rgyas thob par shog/
//sa mo yos kyi lo dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes lnga'i nyin par chu mig dpal gyi sde chen du/ sangs rgyas grags kyis yi ge byas nas sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
